title: Verogen ForenSeq DNA Signature Prep Kit Part 2/5: Indexing
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters as indicated in the protocol interface.

steps.title: Download and unzip files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload your custom labware files with .json extensions, if needed.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file with a .py extension to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette in the OT App using calibration tips (see support articles).

steps.title: Run indexing protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’; the robot will perform the indexing step by transferring each index to its corresponding well in the PCR plate containing samples, then adding PCR2 buffer to each sample and mixing using a fresh tip for every transfer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each index to its matching well in the PCR plate
Add PCR2 buffer to each sample well
Mix each well using a fresh tip for every transfer
